problem.short_description: Checkout failures — customers unable to complete checkout

problem.root_cause: An upstream shared-cache cluster that the search tier depends on was reconfigured during a maintenance window; the change was reverted and the dependency restored. The outage footprint spanned the downstream services that depend on the search tier.
